mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category, knowledge_point, weakness_score, discovered_count, last_discovered_at, status, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_weakness WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category = #{category} AND knowledge_point = #{knowledgePoint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_weakness ( user_id, category, knowledge_point, weakness_score, discovered_count, last_discovered_at, status, resolved_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{category}, #{knowledgePoint}, #{weaknessScore}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'ACTIVE', NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weakness_score = #{weaknessScore}, discovered_count = discovered_count + 1, last_discovered_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'ACTIVE', resolved_at = NULL
